summary.en: Hive Ventures (蜂行資本) is a Taipei-based emerging micro-VC founded in 2019. In June 2021 it closed its debut seed fund at US$13.5M — billed as Taiwan's first dedicated Data & AI fund — backing early-stage AI/enterprise startups in Taiwan and Asia. LPs include Taiwan's National Development Fund.

summary.en: AVA Angels (Angel to Venture Accelerator) is a Taipei early-stage investment platform founded in 2020 by JJ Fang that fuses angel investing with a VC-fund structure (AUM ~US$18M). It launched Taiwan's 'first' angel fund (安發元天使資本) plus a Sustainable Fund, and has backed 30+ startups in AI, green-tech and medical devices.

summary.en: Darwin Angel Fund (達盈天使) is an evergreen angel vehicle launched April 2022 by Taipei VC Darwin Venture Management (達盈管顧, est. 2009) to invest in very-early-stage and research-spinout teams. It writes checks under NT$10M per deal and recycles returns rather than facing a fixed exit window.

strategy.thesis: Early-stage accelerator + micro-fund (Pre-Seed to Series A) for Taiwanese founders targeting global expansion and foreign founders targeting Asia; runs a 3-month program twice a year with seed investment + mentorship + demo day.

summary.en: SparkLabs Taiwan (斯伯克國際創業投資 / SparkLabs Taipei) launched in 2018 as the local arm of the SparkLabs accelerator network, closing an initial US$4.25M first fund (Nov 2018). summary.en: Cherubic Ventures (心元資本) is a Taipei-founded (2014) pre-seed/seed fund run as a solo-GP shop by founder Matt Cheng. Though now sizeable (US$462M cumulative committed across five funds; Fund V at $110M) with 200+ portfolio companies and 12 unicorns, it remains the most prominent Taiwan-origin solo-GP emerging-manager success story.
summary.local: 心元資本（Cherubic Ventures）是 2014 年於台北創立的種子期創投，由創辦人鄭博仁（Matt Cheng）以 solo GP 模式經營。雖已成長至五支基金、累計承諾資本約 4.62 億美元（第五號基金 1.1 億美元）、逾 200 家投資組合與 12 家獨角獸，仍是台灣最具代表性的 solo-GP／新興管理人案例。
